mcat_description.short: RCC Labour Quarter is a prefabricated reinforced cement concrete modular room unit, factory-cast and site-assembled, used as temporary or semi-permanent worker accommodation on construction and industrial sites across India.
mcat_description.long: RCC Labour Quarters are precast concrete modular structures manufactured at a factory and installed on-site, providing durable and cost-effective residential accommodation for construction workers, industrial labourers, and site staff. Rooms are typically cast using RCC sheets or 4-inch concrete slabs for walls and ceilings, with standard room sizes ranging from 11ft × 11ft to 11ft × 22ft and wall heights of approximately 10 feet. The product is sold on a per-square-foot basis inclusive of transportation and installation labour, with buyers specifying total floor area, number of rooms, and optional amenities such as plumbing, electrical fittings, and sanitation. Key differentiators from steel or PUF panel portable cabins are the use of concrete construction, greater structural permanence, lower maintenance, and suitability for multi-year site deployments.

market_context: RCC Labour Quarter is an India-specific B2B product category within the broader prefabricated structures market, referring to factory-manufactured precast reinforced cement concrete room units deployed as worker accommodation on construction, industrial, and infrastructure project sites. The product is distinct from steel/MS portable cabins and PUF panel prefab structures — the RCC construction method offers greater structural durability, lower maintenance, and suitability for multi-year deployments, making it preferred for large-scale labour camps. Manufacturers are concentrated in North India (Agra, Faridabad, Delhi-NCR, Punjab) and West India (Surat, Ahmedabad, Nashik), with supply chains serving pan-India project sites. Standard room dimensions are 11ft × 11ft, 11ft × 15ft, and 11ft × 22ft with 10ft wall height; ceiling and wall panels are cast from RCC sheets or 4-inch concrete slabs (single source — low confidence for exact slab thickness). The product is sold on a per-square-foot basis inclusive of transportation and installation, with buyers specifying total area, room count, and optional amenities. Key buyer segments are construction contractors, industrial plant owners, and government/PSU project departments. The category sits within the broader prefabricated structures taxonomy alongside portable cabins, prefab offices, and compound walls — sellers in this MCAT frequently also manufacture RCC compound walls and precast drainage products.
